title: Halifax Boat Tours

services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: With your family and friends you can can relax, listen to music and enjoy a guided tour of the city from the ocean. As the sun begins to set, we will cruise down to either Bedford Basin or the Northwest Arm to Watch a beautiful sunset over the city. After the sun sets we will make our way back to dock or you can request to dropped off at one of HRM’s many public docks where you can continue your evening further into the city.
